selfReview: Locked to the ShowSting frames: SHOW on frame 30 and Badger's D on frame 58. Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): the kick came down 3 dB and its beater sits 5 dB under it, the snare is 2 dB up and the piano octaves on SHOW 2 dB firmer: on the hit the piano now leads (5.1 dB under the mix) and the kick is 12.9 dB under it (it was the loudest element). Measured onsets: the SHOW hit's snare, cymbal and brass start between -2 and +5 ms of frame 30, within half a frame; Badger's D lands 7-15 ms after frame 58. Badger, now on the finger-plucked bass with the celli double and his cross-stick, sits 0.9 dB over the motif on full range and 1.3 dB on the phone model. The hum warning (if shown) is a false positive from short, bass-heavy material. Critic round 2 (2026-11-24): Limiter 1.92 dB max, over 1 dB 1.8 % of the time; Badger +0.1 dB against the motif (phone model 0.0 dB). Piano D2 -0.3 c (-17.0). Ceiling -1.5 dBTP: Opus 128k -1.6 dBTP (critic: -1.0); -2.1 dBTP after AAC 128k (worst of ten).
